title: Fix the Recursion Without a Base Case
description: The program should compute the factorial of a number using recursion.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 120, the factorial of 5.
actualProblem: There is no base case to stop the recursion, so factorial keeps calling itself with smaller values of n indefinitely, eventually exhausting the call stack and crashing with a stack overflow.
explanation: Every recursive function needs a base case that stops the recursion once the simplest input is reached. Without one, the function calls itself forever and overflows the call stack.
